author: podstow
description: Text to speech MCP server: send articles or AI-written text to a private podcast RSS feed.
name: Podstow

tools.name: submit_url
tools.description: Send the URL of an article, blog post or web page to the user's podstow feed. podstow reads the page, narrates it with text to speech and publishes a podcast episode.

url.description: A complete https:// URL to a publicly readable article.

tools.name: submit_text
tools.description: Publish plain text the assistant wrote (a summary, research report or digest) to the user's podstow feed as a podcast episode, titled with an [AI] prefix.

author.description: Defaults to the connected app's name.

description.description: Short summary shown in podcast apps.

sourceUrl.description: A URL the episode links back to.

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag, such as en, de or fr. Sets the voice.

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List the user's most recent podstow episodes, with titles, links, publish dates and a handle for each transcript.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous call's nextCursor.

tools.name: get_episode_transcript
tools.description: Return the transcript of an episode: an inline preview and a link to the full text.

offset.description: Byte offset where the returned slice starts.

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes to return in the preview.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return the user's plan, article usage and limits, voice preferences, and whether they are set up to listen.

tools.name: show_listen_instructions
tools.description: Show the user how to listen: open podstow on this device, or subscribe to their feed in a podcast app.
